"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"North Korea faces a choice to take verifiable steps toward denuclearization or face increasing isolation and costs from the United States and the international community.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The administration worked with international partners to impose the harshest multilateral sanctions on North Korea in history.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The transfer of nuclear weapons or material by North Korea to states or non-state entities would be considered a grave threat to the United States and its allies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States would hold North Korea accountable for the consequences of transferring nuclear weapons or material to states or non-state entities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
